aliases: County of Provence / 普罗旺斯伯国

nameForms.name: County of Provence
nameForms.note: An imperial fief of the Holy Roman Empire. From 1112 it passed into the Barcelona dynastic sphere; Beatrice's marriage to Charles of Anjou later drew it into the French royal orbit without making it a direct French royal possession.
nameForms.noteCn: 神圣罗马帝国的封建伯国。1112 年后进入巴塞罗那家族的王朝势力圈；贝亚特丽斯与安茹的查理联姻后，伯国进入法国王室势力范围，但并未成为法王直属领地。

holders.note: Ruling countess in her own right; her marriage opened the Barcelona connection.
holders.noteCn: 以自身权利统治的女伯爵；其婚姻开启巴塞罗那家族的联系。

holders.note: Co-ruler through his marriage to Douce I.
holders.noteCn: 因与杜丝一世成婚而共同统治。
继承巴塞罗那—普罗旺斯共同统治者。

holders.note: Last holder of this direct Provençal Barcelona branch.
holders.noteCn: 巴塞罗那家族普罗旺斯直系的最后一位持有人。

holders.note: The Aragonese branch continued the Barcelona dynastic succession.
holders.noteCn: 阿拉贡支系延续巴塞罗那家族的王朝继承。

holders.note: Held the county within the Barcelona-Aragon dynastic complex.
holders.noteCn: 在巴塞罗那—阿拉贡王朝体系内持有伯国。

holders.note: Father of the four Provençal sisters, whose marriages connected England, France, and the Empire.
holders.noteCn: 四位普罗旺斯姐妹之父；她们的联姻连接英格兰、法国与帝国。

holders.note: Ruling countess in her own right; her marriage began Angevin influence.
holders.noteCn: 以自身权利统治的女伯爵；其婚姻开启安茹势力的影响。

holders.note: Held by marriage to Beatrice, not as a French royal-domain grant.
holders.noteCn: 因与贝亚特丽斯的婚姻而持有，并非作为法国王室领地的授予。

holders.note: Angevin succession within the distinct Provençal fief.
holders.noteCn: 独立的普罗旺斯封地内的安茹继承。

holders.note: Held with the Angevin kingdom of Naples.
holders.noteCn: 与安茹的那不勒斯王国一并持有。

holders.note: Ruling countess by Angevin inheritance, retaining Provence alongside her Neapolitan succession.
holders.noteCn: 通过安茹继承成为实权女伯爵，在那不勒斯继承之外保有普罗旺斯。
